newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi mine to start zinc output this month.
newsitem.headline: Saudi mine to start zinc output this month.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's largest gold mine plans to start production of zinc concentrate this month, a Saudi official said on Wednesday.
"The hub commissioning is taking place right now. We should start production of zinc concentrate towards the end of this month," he told Reuters by telephone from Riyadh.
"Naturally, output in the first year will be lower than in the future -- most probably 8,000-10,000 tonnes this year."

He said the mine, which produced about 157,000 ounces of gold and 479,000 ounces of silver last year, had signed a deal with a European company, which would treat the concentrate and sell it on behalf of the Saudi mine.
The mine, Mahd adh Dhahab, is located about 280 km northeast of the Red Sea port of Jeddah.
